description: Story/Gen2. BEATS Silver. Survives map 0, transitions to map 1 and defeats the Gen2-only Silver rival at n4_1 (the placement at bundle.deobfuscated.js:53444-53450), incrementing state.silverBeaten through doSilverNode's win branch, then continues on the parent map before the map-1 boss ends the run. The pre-existing `story_gen2_silver` scenario reaches Silver but LOSES there, so it proves the placement and the encounter but never the win branch -- this scenario is what actually earns the `silver` coverage tag. Also covers starter selection, a catch accept, ordinary trainers, wild battles, pokecenter, two boss encounters, a map transition and a non-Nuzlocke terminal loss. Route derived by a bounded deterministic search over real source runs -- see PLAN.md's M3.1 record.
